races.paceDynamic: Lordsbridge Grey is the only confirmed front runner in this 11-runner field, meaning he can dictate terms without early pressure over the testing Southwell mile. The prominent runners Gallant Lion, Bellasio and Give Me The Night will likely track within striking distance, but the majority of the field comprises hold-up horses including Holly Mist, Avatar Jet, Soames Forsyte, Jamaican Storm, Military Leader and Roaring Ralph. This creates a slow early pace with one horse controlling from the front, followed by a furious late scramble as the back markers attempt to close. This race shape strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can avoid the traffic problems that will engulf the hold-up horses in the final two furlongs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Runner Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Lordsbridge Grey gets an easy lead without early pressure from prominent runners.
scenarios.body: He can dictate conservative fractions and kick clear when the field comes under pressure, with the large pack of hold-up horses unable to make up the deficit. Avatar Jet's recent C&D front-running win proves this tactic works perfectly at this track and distance.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Success
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners positions perfectly behind Lordsbridge Grey and times their challenge.
scenarios.body: They benefit from the slow pace while avoiding the traffic problems behind, getting first run on the tiring leader. The hold-up horses still face the same closing problems but the prominent runner gets the tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Closer Traffic Nightmare
scenarios.trigger: If the large group of hold-up horses bunch up badly turning for home.
scenarios.body: The slow pace helps their finishing kick but multiple horses arrive together creating interference and blocked runs. Only the luckiest hold-up horse with the clearest passage can capitalize, while most are compromised.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Lordsbridge Grey stops quickly after controlling the pace and all prominent runners fade.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure stamina test where only the strongest stayer from the back can reel in a faltering field. This requires everything to go wrong tactically up front while one hold-up horse finds clear water.

watchPoints.text: Avatar Jet may challenge Lordsbridge Grey for the early lead rather than settling, which would completely change the pace dynamic
Watch for bunching and interference in the home straight as multiple hold-up horses arrive together with limited racing room

Bellasio and Gallant Lion both return from long absences which creates fitness doubts despite their tactical advantages
Military Leader's 9lb weight advantage may not be enough to overcome the severe tactical disadvantage facing all hold-up horses

races.paceDynamic: Stella Lucente and Secret Testimony are confirmed front-runners who will contest the early lead, with Northern Tempest likely to press from a prominent position. Stella Lucente has the stronger recent form and more reliable staying power than Secret Testimony who tends to fade, so she should dictate a steady gallop through the middle sections. The large field of hold-up horses (Sporting Light, Real Jack, Yorkshire Queen, Fanjove, Popty Ping, Jungle Knight, Cosmic Man, Everydaysasaturday) will be bunched behind the pace, creating a scenario where the leaders face minimal pressure until the final 2f. This honest pace setup strongly favours prominent runners and those with tactical speed who can position close to the pace without being trapped behind the wall of hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Stella Leads Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Stella Lucente breaks cleanly and Secret Testimony doesn't press her hard early
scenarios.body: Stella Lucente gets an uncontested lead and dictates fractions that suit her stamina, while the hold-up brigade gets caught in traffic behind. Her consistent recent form at this trip gives her every chance to repel late challengers if not pressed early.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuine with Stella Lucente and Secret Testimony going at it from the start
scenarios.body: The early battle creates stronger fractions that set up the race for closers, with the pace horses weakening in the final furlong. The class horses with finishing kicks get their chance to strike.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Northern Tempest can secure an ideal stalking position behind the leaders without being trapped
scenarios.body: Northern Tempest gets first run on the leaders while avoiding the traffic that snares the hold-up horses further back. His trainer Michael Dods is in good form and this represents a slight drop in class.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Secret Testimony leads but fades dramatically turning for home as is his pattern
scenarios.body: The pace completely falls apart when Secret Testimony stops, creating a sprint finish that suits horses with natural speed over this trip. Late runners get maximum benefit from the slow early gallop.

watchPoints.text: Secret Testimony could compromise the entire pace scenario if he shows more early speed than usual and presses Stella Lucente into a duel

races.paceDynamic: Turbo Command is the lone confirmed front runner in this 11-runner field and will likely get an uncontested lead from the gates. With nine hold-up horses and only one prominent runner, the pace will be moderate early before quickening from the 3f pole as the field compresses. The lack of early pressure means Turbo Command can dictate terms and kick for home, while the mass of hold-up horses will need luck in running and room to mount their challenges. This race shape strongly favours early pace and prominent runners who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will engulf the large contingent of hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Turbo Command Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Turbo Command gets soft fractions and kicks clear turning for home...
scenarios.body: The 9yo three-time C&D winner exploits his tactical advantage and holds off late challengers who get hampered in the rush. His prominent style and course knowledge prove decisive against a field full of hold-up horses needing room.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If the large field creates interference and bunching in the straight...
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses struggle for clear runs while those racing handier avoid the worst of the trouble. Fort Augustus and Reputation can find gaps as recent winners with tactical speed.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Surge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If Turbo Command goes too fast early or the pace collapses completely...
scenarios.body: The hold-up brigade gets perfect positioning as the leader comes back to them in the final furlong. Starshot and Megaphone benefit from recent good form and lighter weights.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the favourites underperform and an unconsidered runner finds the perfect trip...
scenarios.body: The step up to 7f unlocks improvement in a lightly-raced type or brings a course specialist back to form. Little Beck Annie or The Cutest capitalize on returning to optimal conditions.

races.paceDynamic: Our Misty Blue will lead from the gates with minimal pressure, as On Key and Mickey Mongoose are the only other front-runners but both can sit just off the pace. This creates a sustainable tempo with the front-runner not being harassed early, allowing him to dictate fractions through the first half-mile. The large contingent of hold-up horses (Tickets, Blue Seeker, Autumn Angel, Shades Of May, Desert Charm, Evoluir) will be bunched at the back, creating a cavalry charge finish. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can track the leader and kick clear before the closers get organized.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Our Misty Blue gets an easy lead without pressure from On Key or Mickey Mongoose
scenarios.body: The front-runner dictates ideal fractions and has enough left to resist the late charge, especially with blinkers helping his focus over this shorter 7f trip. His recent fade over 1m suggests he'll appreciate the distance drop with controlled pace.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Our Misty Blue leads but On Key or Mickey Mongoose track him closely throughout
scenarios.body: The tracker gets first run on the leader turning for home and kicks clear before the hold-up brigade can mount their challenge. The front-runner weakens having been pressed earlier than ideal.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Closer Surges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely with Our Misty Blue going too slow and the prominent horses not pressuring
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get perfect racing room and the closing sectional becomes decisive, with in-form closers having too much finishing kick. Shades Of May's recent C&D win becomes the template.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Meltdown Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If Our Misty Blue goes off too fast trying to avoid pressure or gets into an early speed duel
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the 3f pole with several horses in contention, favouring those with the best recent form regardless of style. Fitness and class separate them in a blanket finish.

watchPoints.text: Our Misty Blue must not repeat his front-running fade from 8 days ago - if he weakens turning for home the race opens up completely
Watch the early positioning of On Key and Mickey Mongoose - if either pressures Our Misty Blue early it changes the entire race dynamic
Shades Of May with 5lb claimer Rose Dawes must overcome the weight burden of recent wins - market support would be telling

races.paceDynamic: Enchant stands as the only confirmed front-runner in this small field, likely to dictate terms from the gates with sustainable fractions given the lack of early pace pressure. Code Girl and Tommie's Angel are complete unknowns but their breeding suggests they could press forward if needed, though this remains speculative. The majority of the field (Jumeirah Sands, Bintaryana, Always Perfect, Hever Beauty) are hold-up horses who will need the pace to develop. This race shape clearly favours prominent runners and those with tactical speed, as the lack of genuine pace-pressers means Enchant can control the tempo and kick clear when ready.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Enchant Controls Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Enchant breaks cleanly and faces no early pressure from the newcomers
scenarios.body: She can dictate ideal fractions and use her proven class to kick clear in the straight, while the hold-up horses struggle to peg back her controlled advantage. Her 319-day break is negated by superior ability and tactical positioning.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Newcomers Press Early
scenarios.trigger: If Code Girl or Tommie's Angel show early pace and challenge Enchant's lead
scenarios.body: This creates a stronger gallop that suits the closers, particularly Bintaryana and Jumeirah Sands who have shown winning form when getting a proper pace to aim at. The front-runners could weaken late under pressure.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Messy Crawling Pace
scenarios.trigger: If all runners sit back waiting and nobody takes the initiative early
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical affair with a sprint finish favouring those with the highest cruising speed and best turn of foot. This scenario particularly suits any newcomer with natural ability breaking through.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Always Perfect Finds More
scenarios.trigger: If Always Perfect can improve significantly from her recent Nottingham run behind Bintaryana
scenarios.body: The 7lb weight swing and potential for further improvement could bridge the gap, especially if she gets a stronger pace to close into than at Nottingham. This requires everything to fall right for the Fellowes filly.

races.paceDynamic: Cold Henry is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate proceedings from the start, likely to set a modest gallop over this extended trip without early pressure. The eight hold-up horses will settle in behind with no obvious prominent racers to force the pace, creating a tactical affair where positioning and timing will be crucial. This sustainable tempo will favor horses with strong finishing kicks who can produce their best work in the final 3-4 furlongs. The race shape strongly favors hold-up horses with proven stamina who can quicken off a slow pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Slow Pace Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Cold Henry sets a pedestrian gallop with no early challengers
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows hold-up horses to conserve energy before unleashing finishing kicks in a bunched finale. Proven stayers with tactical speed will dominate the closing stages.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Henry Maintains Lead
scenarios.trigger: If Cold Henry's sustainable pace proves too strong for late challengers
scenarios.body: The front runner's stamina advantage tells as the field struggles to peg him back over the extended trip. Hold-up horses find the sustained gallop has taken the sting out of their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid Race Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens unexpectedly in the middle stages
scenarios.body: Several horses commit too early trying to improve position, leading to a stop-start rhythm that suits hardy stayers. The race becomes a test of stamina rather than finishing speed.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Sprint Finish Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses make simultaneous moves turning for home
scenarios.body: A frantic final 2 furlongs develops with several hold-up horses arriving together in a photo finish. The handicapper's art comes to the fore with weight differentials proving crucial.
